defect: priority encoder loop may resemble multiple competing output assignments
rationale: The output defaults are assigned before either priority loop, and the valid guard ensures only the selected bit updates the encoded and one-hot outputs. The explicit width cast preserves the selected index width.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the generated priority tree to equivalent LSB/MSB priority combinational loops and renamed the module top.

mutation.description: Two mutually exclusive priority loops write the same outputs after explicit defaults and a one-shot valid guard.
